free.title: Express Entry Document Checklist
free.description: A complete, phase-by-phase list of every document required for an Express Entry profile — FSWP, CEC, and FSTP. Covers the profile stage, ITA, and e-APR submission. Updated for current IRCC requirements.

free.title: IELTS → CLB → CRS Conversion Cheat Sheet
free.description: Every IELTS band score converted to its CLB level and CRS points — for both first and second official language. Includes spouse contribution rows and the exact IRCC table structure.

free.title: ITA to PR: The 11-Step Roadmap
free.description: A visual end-to-end timeline from the day you receive an Invitation to Apply to the day you land in Canada. Includes realistic timeframes for each stage and what happens if a step is delayed.

free.title: The ECA Application Guide
free.description: How to get your foreign education assessed for Express Entry — choosing between the five designated organizations, the professional-body rules for architects, doctors, and pharmacists, the 5-year validity rule, and the mistakes that cost applicants months.

free.title: Employment Reference Letter — IRCC-Compliant Sample Format
free.description: Every element IRCC's completeness check requires in a reference letter — letterhead, supervisor signature, duties, hours, salary and benefits — plus a complete annotated sample letter you can hand to your employer, and the alternative evidence rules for self-employed applicants.

free.title: Reference Letter Request — Employer Template
free.description: A ready-to-send letter that asks your HR department for an Express Entry reference letter with the full IRCC specification built into the request — so the letter comes back compliant the first time. Includes what to do if the company refuses or no longer exists.

free.title: FSWP vs CEC vs FSTP — Eligibility Comparison Table
free.description: The three Express Entry programs side by side: work experience windows and hours, language minimums per program, education and proof-of-funds rules, and the job-offer/certificate gate for skilled trades — with strategic notes on which door to enter through.

premium.title: Letter of Explanation (LOE) Master Template Pack
premium.description: Eight professionally written LOE templates covering the most common explanation scenarios: employment gaps, travel history discrepancies, study-to-work transitions, and more. Each template includes annotated notes explaining what IRCC officers look for.

premium.title: Express Entry Pre-Submission Audit Guide
premium.description: A 40-point audit checklist with worked examples for every section of the e-APR. Covers every common rejection trigger, what to do when a document doesn't match the form exactly, and how to write explanatory notes that satisfy IRCC without triggering a request for more information.

premium.title: CRS Gap Analysis & Score-Boost Action Plan
premium.description: A 20-point diagnostic that identifies exactly where CRS points are being left on the table and what actions would move the score. Covers language band gaps, Canadian experience scenarios, spousal contribution modelling, and when a provincial nominee pathway outperforms waiting for a draw.
